name: @ludion/protocol-types
description: TypeScript types generated from the ludion-protocol JSON Schema snapshot, the editor's bundled pattern schema from the ludion-engine pattern snapshot, and the protocol schema hash (schemaHash.ts) the editor compares with the engine's. Never edit src/protocol.d.ts, patternSchema.ts or schemaHash.ts by hand; run `npm run generate`.

scripts.generate: node scripts/generate.js && node scripts/generate-pattern-schema.js && node scripts/generate-schema-hash.js
